senses.gloss: गृज् or गृञ्ज् (= √ गर्ज्) cl. 1. गर्जति (see √ गर्ज्) or गृञ्जति, to sound, roar, vii, 74 f.
गृञ्ज m. N. of a plant, Car. vi, 21; Suśr. vi.
गृञ्जन m. (n., L.) a kind of onion or garlic or a small red variety of it (prohibited as food), Mn. v, 5; Yājñ. i, 176; Bhpr.; Nyāyam. &c.
the tops of hemp chewed to produce an inebriating effect (the Gāñja), W.
गृञ्जन n. poisoned flesh (meat of an animal destroyed by a poisoned arrow), L.
गृञ्जनक m. (= ˚न) a kind of onion or garlic, Car. i, 27; vi, 9
गृञ्जनक n. the two side-pieces of the hilt of a sword, Gal.
गृञ्जिन (v.l. ˚जिम) m. N. of a son of Śūra and brother of Vasu-deva, Hariv. 1926.
